# Inflation calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/inflation/

Explore how a constant annual inflation assumption changes the future cost of an amount and the purchasing power of a fixed balance.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Estimate what a current expense of 10000 might cost in five years at a 5% annual inflation assumption.

## Limits and checks

The rate is entered by you and remains constant in this model. This is not a live inflation feed or forecast.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
